verdict.rationale: Phaser's evidence shows a first-party catalog of ready-made content: a CLI offering official project templates and demo games, plus a runtime-probed examples index with an API. It also has built-in editor tools (pixel art, tilemap and atlas editors, SFX and music generation). None of this is a large asset store or plugin marketplace, so it only glances at the story. Distribution via npm is a host-platform channel and earns no credit. Missing for 10: a documented asset store or marketplace, a third-party plugin ecosystem, ready-made models or assets for download, and independent evidence of ecosystem breadth.

support.subject: As a game developer, a large asset store or package ecosystem gives me ready-made models, tools, and plugins

citations.quote: This CLI tool presents an interactive selection of official project templates and demo games.
